content.short: Monerium issues regulated on-chain euros (EURe) with real IBANs that move between banks and wallets.
content.description: Monerium is a European e-money institution, based in Iceland, that connects traditional bank rails to blockchains so users can hold regulated euros on-chain and move money between IBANs and wallets instantly. Its flagship token, EURe, is a MiCA-compliant euro e-money stablecoin that comes with a real IBAN, so businesses and individuals can receive SEPA transfers straight into a self-custodied wallet and send euros on-chain like any other token. EURe runs on Ethereum, Polygon and Gnosis Chain and is transferable across them, and Monerium's API powers payments for wallets, card issuers and DeFi projects such as MetaMask and Gnosis Pay. It is a regulated, fully backed euro that lives on public blockchains.
